verdict.rationale: Gitleaks explicitly documents pre-commit hook usage (copying example pre-commit.py into .git/hooks/), and the CLI probe confirms it exits with a failure code on detected secrets, which is exactly the mechanism a pre-commit hook relies on to block commits before they enter history. Community evidence about a maintainer stepping back is about project sustainability, not about pre-commit hook functionality, so it doesn't dispute this capability. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of the pre-commit.py script actually blocking a commit end-to-end, and no mention of the more common pre-commit-framework (.pre-commit-hooks.yaml) integration.
